title: Cups in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
description: Six to Ten of Cups in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, from nostalgia and choice to contentment and belonging, with notes for your tarot spread.

scenes.headline: Cups in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
scenes.caption: The Six to Ten of Cups move from memory and daydreams to contentment and belonging. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.
scenes.vo: The Six to Ten of Cups move from memory and daydreams to contentment and belonging. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

scenes.headline: Six of Cups
scenes.caption: Nostalgia, innocence, kindness. Two children in a courtyard share cups filled with flowers.
scenes.vo: Six of Cups. Nostalgia, innocence, kindness. Two children in a courtyard share cups filled with flowers.

scenes.headline: Seven of Cups
scenes.caption: Options, imagination, daydreams. A silhouetted figure faces a cloud holding seven cups, each containing something different, such as a castle, jewels or a dragon.
